newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE December gilt futures set new contract high.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE December gilt futures set new contract high.

text.p: December gilt futures on LIFFE reached a new contract high on Friday, blipping through the previous top at 111-17.
The contract was 19/32 higher at 111-18 by 1219 GMT.
The gilt's rally was spurred by equally lively core European debt futures. German Bunds and French notionnel futures both broke through to record highs earlier in the session.

Traders said speculation that the Bundesbank may come under pressure to ease German interest rates further was driving debt futures higher. But they said that with U.S. markets closed on Thursday and trading only a half day this session, volume was thin, distorting the strength of the move.
Technical analysts said the next major target for the gilt futures market would be 112-17, the year's high set in January.
